player_prompt.intro:
Mwabienvenue ku Etang Glacé!

Owe ubakisi na 'P' ku nganda.
Mikanda ya nganda:
  ' ' = Se ya barafu (mwenda bwino)
  'H' = Shimo (tua na kupoteza!)
  'G' = Lebo (fikia hii upate!)
  'P' = Kati ya kuwako

Mikomo ya kuweza: juu, chini, kushoto, kulia (oba w, a, s, d)
Toka kitendo chako kama: [up], [down], [left], [right] oba [w], [a], [s], [d]

Lebo: Tembea kutoka kuanzia (juu-kushoto) ku lebo (chini-kulia) bila kuanguka mwingiliano na mashimo yoyote!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomu ya hatua si sahihi. Utumie [up], [down], [left], [right] au [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Dienza dia mudimu didi kadiyi dimanyike '{action}'. Udimune ne: kulu, kuinshi, ku tshianza tshia bakaji anyi tshia balume.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Udi muye ku tshina! Tshisumbu tshijika. Wewe ukadi muenze {pct} % wa luendu lua kudibu bua kufika muaba udi tshipatshila tshiawu.
outcome.turn_limit: Udi mufikishe ku tshipiminu tshia dikudimuna dia njila! Tshisumbu tshidi tshijika. Wewe ukadi muenze {pct} % wa luendu lua kufika muaba uudi musue kuya.
